plugins.name: Jade Drafting Tools
plugins.description: Measure rooms, update area labels and speed up AutoCAD drafting.
plugins.installNotes: AutoCAD LT, Mac and Web are not supported by this package. Workflows assume millimetres; boundary tools need straight, closed 2D linework. The package reports offline validation; confirm new workflows in AutoCAD before project use.

plugins.name: Snyder Detail Library
plugins.description: Save and reuse Revit details and sheets, and coordinate drawing references.
plugins.installNotes: Register the parent Snyder Detail Library folder in pyRevit. Details commands require your Snydex login and the office backend. Only drafting views round-trip; newer Revit detail files cannot open in older Revit. Drawing/reference tools run locally without Snydex login.

plugins.name: Jade’s Templates PSD / AI
plugins.description: Ready-to-use Photoshop assets and Illustrator architectural graphics.
plugins.installNotes: Inside the shared folder, open Jade's Templates PSD AI. Contents listed here are based on the supplied folder screenshot; template files were not included for inspection.

plugins.name: Voronoi Pattern
plugins.description: Create Voronoi patterns and wrap them onto surfaces.
plugins.runsIn: Rhino / Grasshopper · confirm compatibility in your installed version
plugins.installNotes: Open Voronoi Pattern_re.gh from the shared Rhino folder. Component metadata was inspected; the definition has not been executed in Rhino during this update.

tools.name: Hover Measure
tools.short: Displays enclosure areas in m² and edge lengths in mm while hovering inside…
tools.description: Displays enclosure areas in m² and edge lengths in mm while hovering inside selected straight room linework. Assumes closed 2D boundaries at Z=0; cannot trace inside xrefs.
tools.howto:
Use Model space, World UCS and Top view with millimetre linework.
Run JTHOVER and select the room boundary linework.
Hover inside rooms to read areas and edge lengths; Esc finishes.

tools.name: Area Rules
tools.short: Sets AREA_M2 on room blocks whose RM_NAME_BLINE starts with a chosen prefix
tools.description: Sets AREA_M2 on room blocks whose RM_NAME_BLINE starts with a chosen prefix. Runs on demand, rather than enforcing rules in the background.
tools.howto:
Run JTAREARULES.
Enter the room-name prefix and replacement area value.
Apply the rule and review the reported changes.

tools.name: Paint Area
tools.short: Applies one entered area value repeatedly to room-block AREA_M2 attributes or…
tools.description: Applies one entered area value repeatedly to room-block AREA_M2 attributes or standalone area text.
tools.howto:
Run JTPAINTAREA and enter the area value.
Click each room tag or standalone area text to update.
Press Enter or Esc to finish.

tools.name: Revit Plan Pack
tools.short: Combines previously exported floor-plan DWGs into a new drawing, with…
tools.description: Combines previously exported floor-plan DWGs into a new drawing, with side-by-side plans and one working layout per floor. Supports editable imports or linked xrefs; does not export from Revit or copy source title blocks.
tools.howto:
Export Revit floor-plan views as DWGs in millimetres.
Run JTPLANPACK; pick a DWG in the export folder.
Select and order floors, choose editable or linked mode, and set the spacing.
Save to a new output DWG. Check a known distance and configure PAGESETUP, title blocks and viewport scales before printing.

tools.name: Hatch Paint
tools.short: Paints successive enclosed rooms using one set of hatch settings
tools.description: Paints successive enclosed rooms using one set of hatch settings. Supports simple inner holes; generated boundaries do not follow later edits to original wall lines.
tools.howto:
Use Model space, World UCS, Top view and millimetres.
Run JTHATCHPAINT; choose pattern, scale, rotation, colour and transparency.
Select straight, closed room linework, then click inside rooms.
Enter or Esc finishes. Repaint rooms after boundary changes; Undo reverses the session.

tools.name: Good Job Stamp
tools.short: Places a custom message and a drawn smiley face as repeated block inserts
tools.description: Places a custom message and a drawn smiley face as repeated block inserts. Uses a non-plot layer by default.
tools.howto:
Run JTGOODJOB in Model space, World UCS and Top view.
Set the message, text height in mm, rotation, colour and plot option.
Click to place stamps; Enter or Esc finishes.

tools.name: Login
tools.short: Signs in to Snydex using your own account
tools.description: Signs in to Snydex using your own account. The cached session expires after about eight hours.
tools.howto:
Click Snydex › Details › Login.
Enter your Snydex username and password. Sign in again if a tool reports an expired session.

tools.name: Save Detail
tools.short: Publishes the active drafting view as a native Revit detail with a preview and…
tools.description: Publishes the active drafting view as a native Revit detail with a preview and metadata; supports updating an existing library detail.
tools.howto:
Log in and open a drafting view.
Click Save Detail, choose new or update, and complete the title/category prompts.
Save to the library.

tools.name: Insert Detail
tools.short: Searches saved native details and copies one into the project as a new editable…
tools.description: Searches saved native details and copies one into the project as a new editable drafting view.
tools.howto:
Log in, then click Insert Detail.
Search and select a compatible detail.
Find and review the new drafting view in the Project Browser.

tools.name: Save Sheet
tools.short: Saves drafting views on the active sheet as a set, including viewport…
tools.description: Saves drafting views on the active sheet as a set, including viewport positions, title-block information and a sheet preview. Model-based views are skipped.
tools.howto:
Log in and open the sheet.
Click Save Sheet and complete the library prompts.
Review the saved set; only drafting views are included.

tools.name: Insert Sheet
tools.short: Rebuilds a saved detail sheet and positions its drafting views
tools.description: Rebuilds a saved detail sheet and positions its drafting views. Reuses the original title block when that family is loaded.
tools.howto:
Log in and load the required title-block family if available.
Click Insert Sheet and choose the saved set.
Review the rebuilt sheet and any view-placement warnings.

tools.name: Auto Dimension
tools.short: Creates dimension strings for overall grids, grid spacing, walls and individual…
tools.description: Creates dimension strings for overall grids, grid spacing, walls and individual door/window openings in the active view. Review generated references and placement.
tools.howto:
Open the plan view to dimension.
Click Auto Dimension and choose the requested dimension types.
Review all generated dimensions.

tools.name: AutoDimOnline
tools.short: Creates wall dimensions using all levels or a selected level, internal/external…
tools.description: Creates wall dimensions using all levels or a selected level, internal/external faces, an offset and wall-thickness/overall options. The source credits Ahmed Helmy Abdelmagid.
tools.howto:
Click AutoDimOnline.
Choose level scope, dimension face, offset in mm and dimensioning type.
Review the resulting dimensions.

tools.name: CentreTag
tools.short: Moves room location points and room-tag heads to each room’s bounding-box…
tools.description: Moves room location points and room-tag heads to each room’s bounding-box centre in the active view. This also moves the room point; for irregular rooms the box centre may be unsuitable.
tools.howto:
Open the view containing room tags.
Click CentreTag.
Review room points and tags, especially in irregular rooms; undo if the centres are unsuitable.

tools.name: Relabel Directions
tools.short: Renames cardinal directions in view and sheet names using a fixed mapping:…
tools.description: Renames cardinal directions in view and sheet names using a fixed mapping: South → East, North → West, West → North, East → South. Appends an asterisk to updated names. Does not rotate geometry.
tools.howto:
Use only when this fixed direction mapping matches your mirrored/rotated project.
Click Relabel Directions and review the proposed names.
Confirm the rename.

tools.name: Reference Filters
tools.short: Maps view templates to typology codes and uses a visibility matrix to…
tools.description: Maps view templates to typology codes and uses a visibility matrix to coordinate callout, elevation and section references. Creates reference parameters, filters and a REFERENCE CODE view list.
tools.howto:
Click Reference Filters in a project with view templates.
Assign typology codes to templates.
Set which typologies can show each reference type in the matrix.
Apply and review visibility and the REFERENCE CODE schedule.

tools.name: Code New Views
tools.short: Fills blank 1- VIEW CODE and 2- REFERENCED IN parameters from mapped templates
tools.description: Fills blank 1- VIEW CODE and 2- REFERENCED IN parameters from mapped templates. Keeps existing non-blank values.
tools.howto:
Run Reference Filters once to set up the project.
Create or duplicate views and apply mapped templates.
Click Code New Views and review the completion report.

tools.name: Straighten Walls
tools.short: Analyses walls that are slightly off axis or not parallel
tools.description: Analyses walls that are slightly off axis or not parallel. Offers individual wall alignment or rotation of a whole set after analysis; changes can affect connected model elements.
tools.howto:
Select walls for a defined scope, or choose the offered view/model scope.
Click Straighten Walls and review the analysis.
Choose a fix only after checking its scope; review the model afterwards.

tools.name: Voronoi Pattern
tools.short: Generate, extrude and surface-morph Voronoi cells.
tools.description: The definition contains surface dimensions, a rectangle, Populate 2D, Voronoi, Scale, Boundary Surfaces, Extrude, Bounding Box and Surface Morph components. It builds a planar cell pattern and maps geometry onto a target surface.
tools.howto:
Open S:\CADResources\Rhino in File Explorer and copy Voronoi Pattern_re.gh into your project folder.
Open the copied .gh file in Grasshopper.
Set the Surface input to your target Rhino surface if the saved surface is unsuitable.
Adjust the sliders connected to point count, random seed, scale and extrusion; review the pattern and mapped result.
Bake the desired output when ready to work with it in Rhino.
